title: Spin Runner + Pixel Plumber
blurb: Two canvas games. Spin Runner puts you inside a 500 MHz magnet as the magnetization itself: 64 isochromats stepped through the Bloch equations, so resonance, T1, T2* and the spin echo are simulated, not animated, and the run ends in the Fourier transform of the FID you recorded. The echo peaks at 35 ms, not the textbook 2*tau = 40 ms, because the falling T2 envelope drags the maximum earlier.
